title: Multi-creator launch video for the Ivy device

segments.text: Got a bit of an idea that's interesting for a video, which is to sell the Ivy product itself. It's to get several creators and have them talking to the device with the hook being
that the ideas are connected into something like Mr. Beast's viral video that I was watching the other day on YouTube,

The video should be pretty short. I'm thinking that we have it in different hands and different people, and that the goal of the video is to make the product, then the AI, and then the output, and then a video all really seamless, all really fun.

And I think fun is the is the goal, is to make the UI and the AI really personable and really, I guess, optimistic around great ideas and talkative, and we can kind of show the visuals of that rather than lots of fun.
Like to have your thoughts on it and put together some ideas and storyboards and even some demo concepts.

cards.title: Creators talking to the device
cards.gist: A video selling the Ivy product itself by getting several creators to talk to the device on camera.
cards.frame_brief: Multi-creator launch video where different people speak their ideas into the Ivy device.

cards.title: Connect the ideas like that viral video
cards.gist: She wants the creators' ideas to link together the way a viral MrBeast YouTube video she watched did.
cards.their_idea: A viral YouTube video by MrBeast that chains or connects things together.
cards.her_take: Use that connecting-hook structure so the creators' separate ideas link into one thread.
cards.frame_brief: Reference to a viral YouTube format as the structural hook for the launch video.

cards.title: Short video, device passed between hands
cards.gist: Keep it short, pass the device between different hands and people, and show product → AI → output → video as one seamless flow.
cards.frame_brief: Short cut with the device moving between people, showing the whole pipeline seamlessly.

requests.text: Like to have your thoughts on it and put together some ideas and storyboards and even some demo concepts.
